messages:
Nora: Heads-up: VoiceOver is announcing the canary pill and the collapsed row label back-to-back so SR users hear the allocation twice. e.g. "Canary 8 percent. Canary 8 percent." :thinking:
Ben: Repro on macOS/Safari. Looks like both the pill and the container are triggering announcements (aria-live + visible label).
Kemi: NVDA on Windows didn't show it, so seems VoiceOver-specific. Could be the DOM order vs visual order.
Ravi: Quick fix: make the collapsed label aria-hidden="true" and keep a single sr-only aria-live inside the pill component. Minimal change and safer for regressions.
Nora: Also spotted a copy mismatch: action says "Pause rollout" but product intent is to pause that variant only. Recommend "Pause canary" and update tooltip to match.
Ben: There's also a timeline bug: when you scrub back and click rollback, the modal shows current time instead of the selected snapshot time. Confusing for demos.
Kemi: I'll patch modal to read selectedSnapshot.timeISO and add a unit test. Also update modal header to: "Rollback to snapshot v3.1.0  2025-09-03 16:45 UTC" and primary CTA "Rollback to snapshot" (avoid "Confirm").
Ravi: I'll make a small PR with: 1) aria-hidden collapse label + single aria-live, 2) change button/tooltip copy to "Pause canary", 3) add 2px focus ring for tiny variant pills in high contrast. Kemi will own modal timestamp fix.
QAbot: Accessibility scan queued: AR-2025-99 duplicate-live-region (severity: medium).
Nora: Please include VoiceOver + NVDA manual test steps in the PR checklist. I'll validate VoiceOver after the feature flag is on.
Ben: ETA PR tomorrow morning. Thanks team. :thumbsup!
__notes: Design thread: unique wording about VoiceOver double announcements, pause-canary copy, and rollback timestamp. Short Slack-style messages with emoji and a bot notice.
